actual_response.reader_job: A service founder deciding whether a prospective client is a fit; provisional audience because no buyer brief was supplied.
actual_response.decision: The factual first-person story is on hold. No founder interview or actual event was supplied. I cannot turn an invented rejection, client, conversation or lesson into your recollection.
proposed_structure: Moment: the actual client request and what was known at the time.
Goal and constraint: what you were trying to achieve and what made the choice difficult.
Alternatives: the plausible options you actually considered.
Choice and reason: what you decided and why you decided it then.
Observed consequence: what actually happened, including an unresolved outcome if that is the evidence.
Reflection: your present interpretation and the conditions under which the lesson applies.
actual_response.pattern: P02 Founder decision story, pending author-confirmed facts and permission.
actual_response.lower_burden_alternative: Proposed non-autobiographical checklist: Before accepting a project, check whether you understand the requested outcome, can deliver the agreed scope and have the capacity to do the work. If one answer is unclear, resolve it before committing.

alternative_openings.wording: Before accepting a project, check the outcome, scope and capacity.
alternative_openings.payoff: A proposed decision checklist with three explicit checks.

alternative_openings.wording: An unclear project needs a clearer agreement before it needs a yes.
alternative_openings.payoff: A proposed decision principle; no claim that you rejected an actual client.

actual_response.claim_evidence_limit: The checklist is a proposed method, not an observed founder experience or a proven business outcome. A factual story requires the actual episode and confirmation of what was known then versus interpreted now.
actual_response.ending: For the proposed checklist: Resolve the unclear part before you commit. The factual story ending remains unwritten until its real consequence and your reflection are supplied.
actual_response.readiness: Proposed structure complete for review; factual first-person draft not ready for author review.

unresolved_inputs: Author identity and intended buyers
Confirmed event, goal, constraint, alternatives, choice and reason at the time
Observed consequence and current reflection
Permission to disclose the client details and any private information
Author acceptance of the final stance and revision

actual_response.reader_job: A prospective product user assessing what a demonstration establishes; provisional audience.
actual_response.pattern: P09 Build update/release with a bounded demonstration observation.

openings.wording: In one demonstration, review time fell from 12 minutes to 8 minutes.
openings.payoff: The exact supplied observation and its limits.

openings.wording: The demonstration recorded a change from 12 minutes to 8 minutes. Repeatability remains an open question.
openings.payoff: A distinction between the observed demonstration and a repeatable result.

actual_response.illustrative_caption:
In one demonstration, review time fell from 12 minutes to 8 minutes.

The supplied note does not give the sample size, repeated runs or comparator conditions. Those gaps limit what we can conclude about typical review time or what caused the change.

A useful next check would repeat a defined review task under documented comparison conditions and record the outcomes across runs.

claim_evidence_reasoning_limit.claim: Review time fell from 12 minutes to 8 minutes in one demonstration.
claim_evidence_reasoning_limit.type: Attributed observation from the synthetic note
claim_evidence_reasoning_limit.support: The supplied E02 note only; no measurement log was available.
claim_evidence_reasoning_limit.limit: No typical customer saving, causal attribution or repeatability claim follows.

claim_evidence_reasoning_limit.claim: Repeat a defined task under documented comparison conditions.
claim_evidence_reasoning_limit.support: A recommendation prompted by missing repeated runs and comparator conditions.

actual_response.readiness: Illustrative structure complete for review. A factual product caption requires source verification, version/status and the missing measurement context. The synthetic note is not evidence of a real product result.

Sample size, review task and measurement procedure
Repeated-run results and comparable conditions

actual_response.reader_job: A writer choosing whether a document or text best serves a specific explanation.
actual_response.pattern: P01 Evidence-led insight, bounded to the selected sample.

openings.wording: Documents received more reactions than text posts in this intentionally selected reference sample. The comparison leaves the format question open.
openings.payoff: The observed association and the reasons it cannot isolate format.

openings.wording: Before choosing a format from reaction counts, check what else differs between the posts.
openings.payoff: A practical way to inspect a confounded comparison.

actual_response.illustrative_caption:
Documents received more reactions than text posts in this intentionally selected reference sample.

The authors, audiences and topics differed. Those differences can affect the comparison, so this sample does not establish that documents caused the higher reaction counts or will perform better for your audience.

As an editorial choice, use a document when the explanation benefits from a sequence of panels. Use text when readable paragraphs carry the point. A performance comparison would need a defined cohort, comparable observation windows and the relevant differences documented.

claim_evidence_reasoning_limit.claim: The selected sample has more reactions on documents than text posts.
claim_evidence_reasoning_limit.support: E03 supplied description; no underlying rows or counters were available.
claim_evidence_reasoning_limit.limit: Sample size, selection rule, dates and metric aggregation are missing.

claim_evidence_reasoning_limit.support: Intentional selection plus differing authors, audiences and topics.
claim_evidence_reasoning_limit.limit: No causal format effect, representative trend, reach, impressions or conversions can be inferred.

claim_evidence_reasoning_limit.claim: Choose format for the explanatory function.
claim_evidence_reasoning_limit.limit: It is not a distribution or engagement promise.

actual_response.ending: Choose the format that makes this explanation easier to follow; treat a performance claim as a separate question.
actual_response.readiness: Structure complete for review. A factual caption reporting the sample remains on hold pending the exact source set and denominators.

unresolved_inputs: Expected post set, inclusion/exclusion rule and duplicate reconciliation
Document/text counts, observed reaction values, aggregation rule and missingness
Publication dates, observation times and comparison windows
Original post/source access and author/audience/topic context
Any comparable within-author evidence or contrary examples present in the authorized set

openings.payoff: Exactly three named checks, matching the outline.

openings.wording: Who is the buyer, what is the task and what is the alternative?
openings.payoff: The same three-part decision without a numerical hook.

What are they trying to complete?
What would they do or use instead?

actual_response.claim_evidence_limit: This is a proposed diagnostic structure, not evidence of prevalence or performance.
actual_response.readiness: Scoped hook/outline revision ready for author review.

actual_response.proposed_edit: Remove the adjacent humorous sentence. Give the limitation its own literal sentence: Product limitation: [exact approved limitation].
actual_response.instruction_for_final_copy: Replace the bracketed placeholder with the exact source-confirmed limitation. Retain every condition needed to understand it. Keep the joke out of that disclosure; reintroduce humor elsewhere only if it remains clear that the limitation is real.
actual_response.claim_evidence_limit: The packet identifies ambiguity but supplies neither sentence. This is an actionable repair structure, not a completed rewrite or a verified statement of the product limitation. No humor-to-trust or humor-to-reach benefit is assumed.
actual_response.readiness: Repair structure complete for review; final wording on hold until the original joke, limitation and supporting product source are supplied.

Exact limitation, its operating conditions and approved product source/version

actual_response.reader_job: Decide whether a higher publishing cadence is justified by the available material and review capacity.

openings.wording: Before raising your posting frequency, check what the extra posts will add.
openings.payoff: A decision criterion for cadence rather than a universal reversal.

openings.wording: A publishing schedule needs enough distinct, supported material to fill it.
openings.payoff: A practical constraint on the proposed cadence.

actual_response.revised_draft:
A high publishing cadence is a reasonable choice when you have enough distinct, supported material and the capacity to review it.

That is a serious version of the case for posting often. It deserves a better response than calling frequent posts random filler.

My proposed criterion is the contribution of the next post: does it answer a real reader question, add a useful distinction or explain something the previous posts left unresolved?

If the extra posts repeat the same point or depend on unsupported claims, reduce the cadence or narrow the plan. If each adds a clear contribution and can be reviewed properly, a higher cadence may fit.

Set the schedule around the material you can support.
actual_response.claim_evidence_reasoning_limit: This draft offers an editorial recommendation. It supplies no algorithm claim, reach forecast, fixed cadence rule or invented quotation. The opposing position is clearly described rather than attributed to an unnamed expert. The author must confirm that the proposed criterion reflects their actual stance.
actual_response.readiness: Proposed argument ready for author review; acceptance of the author stance remains open.

unresolved_inputs: Author confirmation of the proposed stance
Intended audience and any actual quoted opposing advice requiring source verification
Exact original draft if further fact-preserving line edits are required
outputs.edit_notes: Removed the universal position that posting often is always wrong. Replaced the random-filler caricature with conditions under which higher cadence is reasonable.

actual_response.reasoning: Use the required CTA as a standalone final sentence. The supplied material does not establish the offer scope, proof or fit, so this scoped ending adds no promises or invented service detail.
actual_response.readiness: The exact CTA ending is ready for author review. The surrounding service offer has not been supplied or reviewed.

unresolved_inputs: Current ending and approved service offer if the surrounding copy also needs revision
Offer fit, scope, input/output and support for any service claims
outputs.edit_notes: Preserved the exact CTA, including wording, capitalization and terminal period. Added no guarantee or risk reversal.
